correctness.rationale: The actual generator on an undirected finite simple connected graph yields Lf(s)=1/2 sum_{ij in E}[(a_i/d_i-a_j/d_j)(s_j-s_i)+(a_i h_i/d_i+a_j h_j/d_j)(1-s_i s_j)]. For any affine harmonic fixation f=c+sum a_i s_i, independent Walsh coefficients force edge (a_i h_i/d_i+a_j h_j/d_j)=0 and the degree-normalized a_i/d_i to be graph-harmonic and hence constant. Boundary consensus values give c=1/2 and a_i=deg(i)/(4|E|), forcing h_i+h_j=0. Conversely cancellation makes this affine f harmonic with correct absorbing boundary values; every nonconsensus finite configuration has a positive-probability path to absorption for |h_i|<1. Thus claimed iff, degree-weighted formula and bipartite/odd-cycle corollaries follow. Companion verify.py was read but does not replace the proof.
